description_de: Unverdoppelte 60-Prozent-Referenz aus Level-1-Charakteren mit einer Rang-1-Klassenwaffe, ohne Rüstung und Skillboni. Obere Orientierung für gewöhnliche Level-1-World-Monster, keine garantierte leichte Begegnung für jede Klasse. Die zuvor getestete Verdopplung ist verworfen. Physischer und magischer Angriff sind alternative Referenzen für entsprechende Kreaturen; daraus folgt keine automatische Verwendung beider Angriffsarten.
description_eng: Undoubled 60th-percentile reference from level-one characters with one rank-one class weapon, without armor or skill bonuses. Upper guideline for ordinary level-one world monsters, not a guaranteed easy encounter for every class. The previously tested doubling is discarded. Physical and magical attack are alternative references for corresponding creatures, not automatic dual attack types.
pending: Level growth remains unconfigured and is inherited from the base
Actual starter monsters may use weaker role or variant modifiers
Attack type, skills, model and actual base attack frequency depend on the creature
Physical attack percentile uses physical classes only; magical attack percentile uses mages only; hybrids require separate review
Source: data/balancing/level-one-character-reference.json; quantile uses linear interpolation at index (n-1)*0.6
Health and Mana keep their fractional reference internally and are rounded only after resolution
